problem_title: Landlord withholding security deposit after tenancy expiry
right_summary: Tenant has statutory right to complete refund of security deposit within 30 days of vacating after reasonable deduction for verified actual damages under Tenancy Act.
authority_name: State Rent Authority & District Civil Court
procedure_steps_json: 1. Issue formal written Legal Notice via Registered Post AD / Email demanding deposit refund within 15 days.
2. Preserve rent agreement, rent payment UPI receipts, move-out photos, and handover acknowledgement.
3. If unpaid after notice expiry, file an online grievance with the local Rent Authority or file a Summary Suit before the Civil Court.
required_documents_json: Rent Payment Receipts / UPI Bank Transfer Statement
Notice sent to Landlord & Postal Tracking Receipt

problem_title: Employer non-payment or delayed payment of monthly salary
right_summary: Under Code on Wages 2019 / Payment of Wages Act, wages must be paid before 7th/10th day of the succeeding month. Non-payment attracts recovery proceedings plus compensation.
procedure_steps_json: 1. Send a formal demand letter via email to HR / Employer requesting immediate disbursement of pending wages within 7 days.
2. Register an online grievance on the SAMADHAN portal (samadhan.labour.gov.in).
3. Attend conciliation meeting convened by the Labour Officer for recovery order.
required_documents_json: Pay Slips / Bank Statement showing salary credits stopping
Attendance records / email threads regarding salary demand

problem_title: Unauthorized bank account or credit card debit transaction
right_summary: Under RBI Customer Liability Guidelines, reporting unauthorized transactions within 3 days ensures zero liability for the account holder.
authority_name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal & Bank Nodal Officer
procedure_steps_json: 1. Call 1930 immediately (golden hour) to alert Cyber Financial Fraud unit and freeze fraudulent recipient account.
2. Block debit/credit card immediately via bank banking app or toll-free hotline.
3. Lodge formal complaint on cybercrime.gov.in and submit copy to home bank branch within 72 hours.
required_documents_json: Bank Account Statement showing unauthorized debit
follow_up_timeline: 72 hours for zero liability protection; 30 days for RBI Ombudsman escalation

problem_title: Seller refusing refund/replacement for defective product or service
right_summary: Consumer Protection Act 2019 guarantees rights against unfair trade practices and product liability claims.
procedure_steps_json: 1. File a complaint on National Consumer Helpline (NCH) app / site (consumerhelpline.gov.in) or call 1915.
2. Send written notice to manufacturer/seller requesting replacement or full refund within 15 days.
3. If unresolved, file an e-complaint on e-Daakhil (edaakhil.nic.in) before District Consumer Commission.
follow_up_timeline: 15 days for merchant reply; 21 days for Consumer Court admission
